items.title: 7 Sci-Fi Shows Fans Either Love Or Hate
items.summary: Sci-fi TV shows are notoriously difficult to get right. The genre’s fandom can be fickle, and even the grandest ideas or most impressive visual spectacle cannot guarantee a series will succeed. Even the most celebrated sci-fi shows have detractors who are every bit as vocal as their supporters. The idea of a universally beloved science fiction series is basically a myth. items.title: 5 Near-Perfect Fantasy Books, Recommended by Brandon Sanderson
items.summary: Brandon Sanderson is one of the most popular authors in the fantasy genre right now , yet he never misses a chance to pay his success forward. Sanderson has made headlines for steering the publishing industry itself and advocating for other writers along the way. His story of single-minded focus on becoming a professional author is inspiring to many readers, and he often encourages aspiring young writers to read as much as possible. items.summary: Her Jessica Chastain-starring Netflix drama "Heartland" is the latest entry in Feste's distinct canon. It's a space where, she tells IndieWire, women aren't "unlikable," they're just more nuanced, more complicated, and way more able to get shit done.
items.t: In Shana Feste’s Films, Gender-Flipping Cinema’s ‘Tradition of Celebrating Damaged Men’ Is Its Own Reward

items.title: ’12 12 12′ Review: Anthony Mackie and Jamie Dornan’s Ticking-Clock Heist Thriller Runs on Broken Time
items.summary: An FBI agent out for revenge. A thief planning one last score. You know the story, but in Dudi Appleton and Jim Keeble's convoluted Apple series, you can watch it unfold across three non-chronological timelines.
items.t: ’12 12 12′ Review: Anthony Mackie and Jamie Dornan’s Ticking-Clock Heist Thriller Runs on Broken Time

items.title: Jensen Huang’s Biopic Feels Inevitable — The Right One Might Be Impossible
items.summary: After "The Social Reckoning" stumbled at the box office and voter backlash over data centers dovetailed with awards buzz for "Artificial," any film about the former Nvidia exec would have to keep pace with a tech industry that’s changing by the day.
items.t: Jensen Huang’s Biopic Feels Inevitable — The Right One Might Be Impossible

items.title: Miles Teller Opens Up About ‘Paper Tiger,’ Adam Driver, and Losing His Home Before Filming James Gray’s Movie
items.summary: In James Gray's Cannes hit about two brothers falling out with the Russian mafia, Teller plays against type as a sensitive family man opposite Adam Driver and Scarlett Johansson.
items.t: Miles Teller Opens Up About ‘Paper Tiger,’ Adam Driver, and Losing His Home Before Filming James Gray’s Movie

items.title: ‘The Good Daughter’ Review: Rose Byrne Sizzles in Peacock’s Brutal Trauma-Drama About Crime-Solving Sisters
items.summary: The clichés stack up nearly as fast as the clever cast can distinguish them in Karin Slaughter's six-episode adaptation of her own book, which follows long-separated sisters who reunite to defend a young woman from the predators lurking in their brutish, backwoods hometown.
